svg.title: Figure 3-1. LD-SDA verification and validation hierarchy (WP-V-01 §3)
svg.desc: The right side of the V for LD-SDA, level by level against the element hierarchy of WP-C-01 Figure 3-1. Item: safety validation VS-VAL in WP-V-01, 31 specified cases, validates the safety goals SG-01 to SG-07, the assumptions of use and the external measures; SOTIF validation in WP-V-02 to WP-V-04 is out of scope of WP-V-01. System: system verification VS-SQ in WP-S-09, 19 cases, in the reference vehicle, and system integration and test VS-SI in WP-S-08, 27 cases, on the HIL bench. Components: hardware integration and verification VS-HW in WP-H-06, 21 cases, verifies E-04 device hardware and E-05 harness; ML model testing VS-ML in WP-W-10, 12 cases, verifies E-02; embedded software testing VS-SWQ in WP-W-08, 26 cases, and software integration and verification VS-SWI in WP-W-07, 19 cases, verify E-03; E-01 is QM, its interface to the panda is covered by VS-SWI. Units: software unit verification VS-UV in WP-W-06, 23 cases, verifies the 17 E-03 units. Fault injection VS-FI in WP-V-05, 31 cases, cuts across the unit, SoC, HIL and vehicle levels. Every one of these specifications records its results as not yet executed.

Specified cases: rows whose first column is the case ID, as counted by assurance/trace/tools/trace_map.py (trace map §2). “Cases name”: requirements of the paired level named by at least one case (trace map §5).
Nothing on this page has run as recorded evidence; CI host tests exist for VS-UV and VS-SWI but no run is archived. E-06 (excluded, WP-C-01 OI-4) is not shown.
